title: Spring Boot 启动阶段、事件顺序与 @Conditional 装配
expected_output:
=== SpringApplication.run() pipeline (simulated) ===
  1. new SpringApplication(App.class)   -> deduce type SERVLET
  2. prepareEnvironment()                -> load application.yml + args
  3. printBanner()
  4. createApplicationContext()          -> AnnotationConfigServletWebServerApplicationContext
  5. prepareContext()                    -> run ApplicationContextInitializer
  6. refreshContext()                    -> parse @Import/@Conditional, register BeanDefinitions

=== events published, in order ===
  1. ApplicationStartingEvent
  2. ContextRefreshedEvent
  3. ApplicationStartedEvent
  4. ApplicationReadyEvent

=== @Conditional evaluation for DataSourceAutoConfiguration ===
  @ConditionalOnClass(java.sql.Driver)      : true
  @ConditionalOnMissingBean(DataSource)     : true
  -> auto-configuration applied             : true

=== user registers own DataSource first ===
  @ConditionalOnMissingBean(DataSource)     : false
  -> auto-configuration applied             : false
  => user-defined bean always wins (autoconfig is a default, not a mandate)

=== fail-fast when driver is absent ===
  startup aborted at refreshContext: driver class not found
  (context never reaches ApplicationReadyEvent)
